notes: Three buildings: 2465 NE Alberta St (34 doors: 32 apts + 2 retail, 2025, 0/34 occupied), 3727 S Hood Ave (18 micro-units, 2024, 18/18 incl. 2 Airbnb units), 11 NE 55th Ave (16 units, 2025, 7/15 leased). Ask $15,949,700; broker pro forma NOI $930,998 (5.84% blended cap).
Broker pro forma: total gross income $1,342,219 (rents $1,221,888 + billbacks/fees/misc $120,331), vacancy 3.9%, opex $363,772 (28% of EGI; Alberta at 24.8% / $5,505 per unit).

Normalized: remove Airbnb premium ($24K), late fees ($6K) and half of unexplained Alberta misc income ($18K); 7% economic loss for lease-up, concessions and bad debt; opex rebuilt at $6,850/unit Alberta, ~$5,900/unit Hood and Tabor incl. reserves, realistic insurance and admin = $433K (36% of EGI).

LIHTC conversion (for-profit): 60% AMI 2026 caps (studio $1,347, 1BR $1,443, 2BR $1,732 gross) less utility allowances trim ~$66K/yr of rent on the 1BR/2BR units; +$25K compliance cost; NO acquisition credits because all three buildings were placed in service within 10 years (IRC 42(d)(2)(B)(ii)) and there is no rehab basis.

Nonprofit affordable ownership: same restricted rents but ORS 307.540/541 property-tax exemption removes ~$153K/yr of taxes. Available only to a 501(c)(3)/(4) owner approved by Portland Housing Bureau.
Debt for all scenarios: 65% LTC conventional at 6.625% / 30-yr. Capital budget = $250K lease-up concessions and retail TI reserve. Closing 2%.
ARV = normalized NOI capitalized at 6.0% (Portland 2026 market average 5.9% to 6.2%).

scenarios.label: Broker pro forma as presented
scenarios.description: All 68 doors at pro forma rents including vacant Alberta and Tabor units, Airbnb income, 3.9% vacancy, 28% opex.

scenarios.label: Normalized market-rate underwriting
scenarios.description: Airbnb and fee income removed, 7% economic loss through lease-up, opex rebuilt to $433K with reserves.

scenarios.label: LIHTC conversion, for-profit owner (no credits)
scenarios.description: Rents capped at 60% AMI net of utility allowance, 5% vacancy on waitlist demand, +$25K compliance; no tax exemption; zero acquisition credits under the 10-year rule.

scenarios.label: Nonprofit affordable ownership with tax exemption
scenarios.description: Same restricted rents; property tax removed under ORS 307.540; compliance added. Requires 501(c)(3) owner and PHB approval.
